name: Runemaster Kirin Tor Agent grants its rune-cooldown buff on Eye of the Beholder cast (#2767)
contract: Kirin Tor Agent 705634 Effect0 is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL, ProcChance 100, trigger 706422. Spell.dbc
ProcFlags is 0 and, before the fix, no spell_proc row existed, so casting Eye of the Beholder never granted
706422. Eye of the Beholder 500121 (the Runemaster family 38 record, per runemaster-eye-of-the-beholder.json)
is a positive self-buff (ADD_PCT_MODIFIER on the caster), DmgClass magic, SpellFamilyFlags1 4: at cast phase
Spell.cpp only sets PROC_FLAG_DONE_SPELL_MAGIC_DMG_CLASS_POS (0x4000) for a beneficial magic-class cast, so
the fix scopes the row to ProcFlags 0x4000, cast phase, family 38 mask1 4. Expected: without the talent
casting Eye of the Beholder never applies 706422; with it, the very next cast applies it immediately.

steps.label: SETUP: Eye of the Beholder is active
SETUP: without the talent, no Kirin Tor Agent buff
SETUP: Kirin Tor Agent is active
CONTRACT: casting Eye of the Beholder grants the Kirin Tor Agent buff
